Comment: Etendo Go edge security headers v2 for HTML documents: enforced CSP, XFO DENY, no-store (ETP-4574, ADR-0002). CSP_CONNECT_ORIGINS is rendered at load time and fails closed.
Name: etendo-go-security-headers-v2

ContentSecurityPolicy.ContentSecurityPolicy: default-src 'self'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none'; img-src 'self' blob: data:; frame-src 'self' blob:; connect-src 'self' https://dataplane.rum.eu-west-3.amazonaws.com {{CSP_CONNECT_ORIGINS}}; upgrade-insecure-requests; report-uri /sws/go/csp-report; report-to csp-endpoint
